CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

Package Overview

fast_rc is an R package that provides fast reverse complement operations for DNA/RNA sequences via Rcpp (C++ integration). The core function fast_rc() uses a static lookup table for O(1) complement mapping with full IUPAC ambiguity code support.

Build and Development Commands

# Load package for interactive development (compiles C++ code)
Rscript -e 'devtools::load_all()'

# Generate documentation and NAMESPACE from roxygen2 comments
Rscript -e 'devtools::document()'

# Run all tests
Rscript -e 'devtools::test()'

# Run a single test file
Rscript -e 'testthat::test_file("tests/testthat/test-FILENAME.R")'

# Full R CMD check
Rscript -e 'devtools::check()'

Architecture

  • src/rast_rc.cpp — The core C++ implementation. Exports fast_rc(CharacterVector seqs, std::string type) to R via Rcpp. Supports DNA (A↔︎T) and RNA (A↔︎U) modes with case-insensitive IUPAC complement mapping and NA preservation.
  • R/fast_rc-package.R — Package-level roxygen2 directives; imports Rcpp::sourceCpp.
  • tests/testthat/ — testthat edition 3 test files.
  • NAMESPACE is auto-generated by roxygen2; do not edit manually.
